findings.title: Close adapter state/error combinations lack a complete oracle
findings.evidence: Section 9 defines {state: closed|still_open|unknown, err} without constraining state when err is non-nil. FI-CLOSE-01a limits DB.Close errors to still_open or unknown; other close rows similarly omit closed+err handling.
findings.recommendation: Either forbid closed+non-nil-error and classify ambiguous results as unknown, or define the close-sequence, poison/return, and retry behavior for closed+err and add assertions. Keep database/sql aggregate handle proof distinct from raw handle close.
